dollar_stop.applied: sideoracle_price clears all three rungs and every price-pair p_star is at most 0.90 with W strictly greater than L. S1 is the named successor and does not start inside S0.

verbatim.KILL: On the locked gated denominators, sideoracle_price misses a rung, a price pair p_star exceeds 0.90, or W is not strictly greater than L. The side reduction at age 180 closes. B0 is the named successor and does not start inside S0.
verbatim.LIVE: sideoracle_price clears all three rungs and every price-pair p_star is at most 0.90 with W strictly greater than L. S1 is the named successor and does not start inside S0.

label: Exploratory side-conditioned identity ceiling on stored teacher cash. It can kill or price S1 and cannot promote.

cellbest_control.causal_status: oracle identity with the frozen enter-positive law

sideoracle_earliest.causal_status: oracle side and causal earliest CLEAR within side

sideoracle_price.causal_status: oracle side and roster hindsight within side

sideoracle_price_ready.causal_status: oracle side and READY-only price-order control

rule: For each joinable cell, define the oracle side from the READY row with maximum cert_close_usd, tied by smallest candidate_id. Score the frozen six lines using either side-relative entry price or earliest decision. Reduction lines select from CLEAR rows without a positivity filter.

side_accuracy.assumption: First-order linear bound. Side-caller errors are assumed to distribute like the matching wrong-side line.
